description: We are a team of curious minds and aspiring explorers fascinated by the mysteries of our universe, the origins of Earth, and the science behind the world around us. We believe that every great discovery starts with curiosity, creativity, and the courage to ask questions. We are looking for enthusiastic, open-minded, and friendly people who enjoy exploring new ideas, solving problems, and working together. Skills in programming, data analysis, scientific research, graphic design are welcome!
